description: This file defines a React functional component 'CreateMCPServer' used for creating and configuring a new MCP Server within a dashboard UI. It includes form handling, state management, OAuth flow integration, and UI elements for specifying server parameters, authentication, and permissions.

classes.name: CreateMCPServer
classes.description: React functional component for creating MCP Server with form fields, OAuth flow handling, and integrated sub-components.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating a new MCP server, including data transformation, validation, and API call.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal dialog without submitting.

methods.name: handleTransportChange
methods.description: Updates form state based on selected transport type, clearing irrelevant fields.

methods.name: getAccessGroupOptions
methods.description: Generates options for access groups, including an option to create new groups if not matched.
